# Requirements

A room is one transcript shared by several agents and the user, with a chain of command: the most senior member that can answer speaks last, reviews the others' work and makes the final call.

## Requirement 1: A room is a thread with a roster

**User Story:** As a user, I want to put two or more of my agents in a room so that they can work one problem together while each keeps its own memory.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a room is created THE server SHALL require at least 2 real agents and at most 8, answer 400 otherwise, and open it with a system line naming the members.
2. WHEN an agent is in several rooms THE provider session SHALL stay keyed to the agent, so what it heard in a room is still in memory in a direct chat.
3. WHEN a room is stored THE record SHALL live in rooms.json under ~/.workmates (0o600 in a 0o700 directory) and its transcript in messages-<roomId>.json, the room id doubling as the thread id.
4. WHEN an agent is deleted THE server SHALL drop it from every room's roster.
5. WHEN a room is archived THE transcript and members SHALL be kept; only an explicit delete removes anything, and delete cascades to routines and workflows that target the room.

## Requirement 2: Who a message reaches

**User Story:** As a user, I want to talk to the whole room or to one agent by name so that a message wakes exactly who it is for.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a message names nobody THE message SHALL reach every member that can answer, in room order.
2. WHEN a message contains @Name THE message SHALL reach only those named, matched case-insensitively, longest name first, with each match blanked out so @Bobby Tables never wakes Bo.
3. WHEN a named member is archived THE room SHALL post one notice that it will not answer, and resolve names against the whole roster so naming an archived member is not naming nobody.
4. WHEN leadOnly is set and a user message names nobody THE message SHALL reach only the most senior member that can answer.
5. WHEN an agent speaks THE message SHALL reach only whom it named, never itself, except a kickoff brief marked toAll.

## Requirement 3: Juniors first, the senior last

**User Story:** As a user, I want the senior agent to speak after the others so that its final call is made on work it actually saw.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN several members are to answer THE server SHALL run their turns sequentially in ascending seniority, waiting for each to go idle before the next.
2. WHEN the speaker is the lead THE briefing SHALL say it is the most senior and speaks last, delegates legwork with @Name, verifies rather than restates, makes the call when members disagree, and ends with one short verdict.
3. WHEN the speaker is not the lead THE briefing SHALL name the lead as the one with the final say and instruct the member to end its turn with @Lead and one line.
4. WHEN a turn completes in a room THE server SHALL pass the room to anyone that agent named, up to 3 agent-triggered hops per human message, queueing mid-round handoffs rather than talking over the round.
5. WHEN one member's turn fails or is refused THE others SHALL still run and the refusal SHALL appear as a readable notice, never silence.
6. WHEN the room is fed to a speaker THE transcript SHALL be the last 30 non-deleted, non-queued text messages, labelled by speaker.

## Requirement 4: Queued, edited, taken back

**User Story:** As a user, I want to keep typing while the room is busy so that my messages are visible at once and run in order.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a message is posted while a dispatch is running THE server SHALL store and broadcast it as queued, answer 202, and run it after the current loop.
2. WHEN a queued message is edited before it runs THE current text SHALL be used; WHEN it is deleted THE run SHALL not happen.
3. WHEN a decision card in a room is answered THE server SHALL send one queued @Name reply and refuse a second concurrent choice with 409.
4. WHEN a human posts THE server SHALL reset every member's hop count so a fresh chain starts.

## Requirement 5: Teams, desks and the room screen

**User Story:** As a user, I want to hire a team into a room and give it a shared folder so that a room arrives with a lead, a brief and a place to work.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a senior agent proposes a team in a workmates-team fence THE server SHALL turn it into an options card and hire nothing until the user chooses Hire the team.
2. WHEN a team is hired THE server SHALL create the hires at seniority 1 on the cheapest model of the lead's provider, open the room with the lead, and have the lead post its brief to all.
3. WHEN a manifest is imported THE server SHALL validate the folder before creating anything, clamp every member field, and refuse fewer than 2 members; export carries roles and never ids, cursors or transcripts.
4. WHEN a room first dispatches a turn THE desk SHALL be pinned to its cwd or to null forever; a later cwd change answers 409.
5. WHEN the room screen renders with more than one member THE header SHALL show a crown and the sentence that the lead is most senior here and has the final call, computed over the members that can answer.
6. WHEN an agent calls the API THE agent SHALL see the roster of every room but read, post in and change only rooms it is a member of, and delete none.
